title: Friendly and Formal Letters
summary: The purpose, format, register and language of friendly letters and formal letters (complaint, request and application), with examples and a checklist.

rows: Share news, thank, congratulate, sympathise, invite
Complain, request, apply, inquire, give an opinion
Formal, polite, clear and concise; no slang or contractions
Yes, e.g. RE: APPLICATION FOR A PART-TIME POSITION
Yours faithfully (if you used Sir/Madam) / Yours sincerely (if you used a name)

notes.title: Example friendly letter (original)
notes.text:
14 Jacaranda Street
Polokwane
0699
12 May 2025

Dear Lerato,

Thank you so much for the book you sent for my birthday! I started reading it on the bus and nearly missed my stop.

Guess what? Our soccer team made it to the district final. Coach says we have a real chance if our goalkeeper stops letting in silly goals (that's me, by the way).

How is life in Cape Town? Is it true that the wind blows people off the pavement? Write back soon and tell me everything.

Love,
Karabo

notes.title: Friendly or formal?
notes.problem: Which is suited to a letter to your cousin: 'Dear Sir, I hereby inform you of my visit' or 'Hi Thabo, guess what, I'm coming to visit!'?
steps: A cousin is someone you know well.
Friendly letters use a first-name greeting and a relaxed tone.

items: Sender's address (top right or top left) and date.
Subject line (RE:) in capitals or underlined.
Introduction: state the purpose of the letter.
Body: one main point per paragraph, with facts and details.
Conclusion: what you want to happen, and thank the reader.
Closing (Yours faithfully / Yours sincerely), signature and full name.

notes.title: Example formal letter of complaint (original)
notes.text:
PO Box 455
KwaDukuza
4450
3 March 2025

The Manager
Sunrise Electronics
22 Main Road
KwaDukuza
4450

Dear Sir/Madam

RE: FAULTY HEADPHONES PURCHASED ON 20 FEBRUARY 2025

I am writing to complain about a pair of wireless headphones that I bought at your store on 20 February 2025 for R499 (receipt no. 10234).

After only five days, the left earpiece stopped working. When I returned to the store, the assistant refused to help me and said that the problem was my fault.

According to the Consumer Protection Act, I am entitled to a repair, replacement or refund for faulty goods returned within six months. I would therefore appreciate a replacement or a full refund.

Thank you for your attention. I look forward to your reply.

Yours faithfully
S. Mthembu
Sibusiso Mthembu

notes.label: Remember
notes.text: **Dear Sir/Madam** → **Yours faithfully**. **Dear Mrs Pillay** → **Yours sincerely**. Keep formal letters short, polite and to the point.

notes.title: Fixing the ending
notes.problem: A letter to a school principal begins 'Dear Mrs Naidu' and ends 'Yours faithfully'. Is that correct?
steps: 'Yours faithfully' goes with 'Dear Sir/Madam', when you don't use the name.
